stem: A bus starts from rest with an acceleration of 2 m/$s^{2}$, and at the same instant a man starts running after the bus at a constant speed of 10 m/s. If he is $x$ m behind the bus, then what is the maximum value of $x$ so that the man may be able to catch the bus?

assets.alt: Position–time graph in m and s: a bus's parabola t² from 0, and a man's straight line 10t − 25 from −25 m that is tangent to it at t = 5 s, where both have speed 10 m/s.
